Housekeeper (Maids and Housekeeping Cleaners) - Hiring Announcement

Our company is hiring a housekeeper (maids and housekeeping cleaners) to join our team. The role involves the core work of the occupation summarized below.

Key responsibilities:
- Keep storage areas and carts well-stocked, clean, and tidy
- Carry linens, towels, toilet items, and cleaning supplies, using wheeled carts
- Clean rooms, hallways, lobbies, lounges, restrooms, corridors, elevators, stairways, locker rooms, and other work areas so that health standards are met
- Disinfect equipment and supplies, using germicides or steam-operated sterilizers
- Empty wastebaskets, empty and clean ashtrays, and transport other trash and waste to disposal areas

Requirements: Active Listening, Speaking, Critical Thinking, Monitoring, Reading Comprehension, Writing; several years of relevant experience; strong communication skills and reliability. Competitive salary and benefits offered.

To apply, submit a resume and a short cover note.
